title: Transitions of Care Medical Assistant - Member Outreach
description:
Job Description
A bit about this role:
We want to help members navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way. The Transitions of Care (TOC) Team supports members who are newly discharged from the hospital (and in some cases prior to discharge). You’ll serve as an advocate for these members, coordinating care and ensuring they have the necessary resources and support to achieve better health outcomes. As a TOC Associate your goal will be to support members in safely recovering at home and to prevent hospital readmissions. Our ideal TOC Associate is caring, compassionate, energetic, and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.
Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

• Calling (inbound/outbound) patients to check in after discharge to see how they are doing, and that they have received the assistance they need.

• Work with affiliated vendors to coordinate services and care for members, to include transportation, DME, meals, home health care and more as appropriate.

• Assisting with scheduling of post discharge TOC APP, PCP, and Specialist visits.

• Collaborate with patients, providers, and caregivers to ensure a positive outcome.

• Working hand in hand with the other members of the TOC team to address patient needs towards team based goals. This may include interdisciplinary huddles.

• Participating in and assisting with pilot programs.

• Coordinating with medical providers and facilities to access necessary discharge records.

• Following escalation processes to the clinical team to ensure patients get needed evaluation and care.

Required skills and experience:

• An active and clearMedical Assistant Certification

• 2-3 Years of Experience in healthcare, managed care, home health, and/or community health setting

Desired skills and experience:

• Fully bilingual in English and Spanish

Salary Range: $23.00 - $27.00 / hour
The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.
Our Total Rewards package includes:

• Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

• Generous paid time off

• $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

• Stock options for all employees

• Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

• Parental leave program

• 401K program

• And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.
Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going - all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

title: FDE Subject Matter Expert
description:
Description
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.
Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.
Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.
Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.
What you will do

• Design and build the projects students work on end to end - scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.

• Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently.

• Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.

• Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.

• Contribute to sales and marketing enablement - training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

Requirements

• 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).

• Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments - first call through production go-live and adoption.

• Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).

• Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.

• Strong written communication in English - you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.

• Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

• Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.
What we can offer you

• Fully remote work.

• A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.

• Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.

• A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.
We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. Summary
The FIU Fraud Data Analyst is responsible for using data, investigative judgment, and fraud analytics to identify, investigate, and mitigate internal and external financial crime risks against the Bank. This role analyzes large and complex datasets, fraud alerts, customer and transaction activity, and emerging fraud trends to support timely risk-based decisions, reduce fraud losses, strengthen controls, and ensure regulatory expectations are met. The position partners with FIU leadership, Fraud Operations, Digital Banking, Treasury Management, Information Technology, Information Security, Compliance, and other business partners to develop actionable insights, improve fraud detection strategies, and support effective reporting and escalation.
It is the policy of SouthState Bank to comply with the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the requirements of the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and other related anti-money laundering/ anti-terrorist financing initiatives. The Bank has established a Bank Secrecy Act/ Anti-Money Laundering/Office of Foreign Assets Control (BSA/AML/OFAC) Compliance Program, covering all requirements of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act and OFAC rules and regulations. Upon completion of required training, the Board of Directors of SouthState Bank shall hold each employee accountable for adhering to the established operating procedures and internal controls as set forth in the Bank’s BSA/AML/OFAC Program. Continued instances of non-compliance or willful violation of law may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.
Duties & Responsibilities

• Evaluate fraud detection rules, monitoring logic, alert performance, false positives, and data quality issues; recommend enhancements to improve detection effectiveness and operational efficiency

• Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, recurring reports, trend analyses, and ad hoc data views to identify fraud patterns, emerging typologies, control gaps, and loss exposure

• Identify emerging fraud trends, attack patterns, mule activity, account takeover indicators, synthetic identity concerns, suspicious online account opening activity, social engineering indicators, and other financial crime risks

• Query, extract, validate, and analyze large datasets using SQL-based databases, Snowflake, Excel, and other approved analytical tools to support fraud investigations and strategy development

• Analyze fraud alerts, account activity, customer behavior, transaction patterns, and other data sources to identify unusual, suspicious, or potentially fraudulent activity

• Research and analyze high-risk transactions across payment channels, including digital banking, Zelle, Bill Pay, Bank-to-Bank transfers, debit card, wires, ACH, checks, and other products as applicable

• Communicate internal control deficiencies, data limitations, system issues, and fraud vulnerabilities identified during analytical or investigative work

• Provide analytical support, peer guidance, training, and subject matter expertise to team members as needed

The work in front of you is concrete. A .NET estate of roughly 80 repositories to bring onto .NET 8 against a hard support deadline. Tenant isolation in a HIPAA platform that needs to be made provably right, not just believed to be. A CI pipeline that costs eighteen minutes a change and should cost a fraction of that. Building with AI, and building AI

• Evaluate emerging capability on a regular rhythm, measure its real impact, and retire what stops earning its place.

• Ship AI into the product: clinical documentation, patient communication, and the intelligence our clinics’ data makes possible, built to HIPAA and GDPR standards from the first design.
Multiplying the organization

• Take the hardest reviews in the codebase, and teach through them rather than gate.

• Partner with product leadership so that the systems you design are built for where the business is going, not where it has been.
Requirements

• Daily use of coding agents in your own engineering work.

• At least one production feature built on large language models that you shipped and operated.

• Written and spoken communication that works across time zones and with colleagues whose first language is not English. Most of our engineers are in Latin America.

title: Researcher, Misalignment Monitoring Lead
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI's Safety Research organization works to ensure that our most capable AI models can be deployed safely and responsibly. As frontier models become increasingly capable and autonomous, developing reliable ways to monitor their behavior, identify emerging risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of safety systems becomes increasingly important.

Our work focuses on advancing the research and evaluation methods needed to understand model behavior and ensure that monitoring systems remain effective as model capabilities evolve. We combine rigorous empirical research with practical safety interventions, working closely with research, engineering, and deployment teams to translate findings into improvements across OpenAI's models and products.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior researcher to lead technical work on misalignment monitoring for frontier AI systems. You will develop methods to evaluate the effectiveness of AI monitors, understand their limitations, and improve our ability to detect and stop concerning model behavior reliably.

This role combines research leadership with hands-on technical execution. You will set research priorities, design rigorous evaluations, investigate monitoring failures, and develop approaches for stress-testing and improving monitoring systems. A key focus will be understanding where monitors produce false positives, miss important behaviors, or become less effective as models grow more capable.

You will work closely with researchers and engineers across OpenAI to turn monitoring research into practical improvements to our safety systems. We are looking for someone with strong research judgment, technical depth, and the ability to independently drive ambiguous problems from initial investigation through measurable results.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead the research and technical direction for evaluating and improving the misalignment monitoring of frontier AI systems.

- Design and execute rigorous evaluations that measure monitor effectiveness, identify failure modes, and assess the reliability of monitoring signals.

- Develop methods to stress-test and red-team monitors, including identifying behaviors that evade detection or expose weaknesses in existing approaches.

- Investigate false positives, missed detections, and other monitoring failures to improve the accuracy and usefulness of safety evaluations.

- Build scalable evaluation frameworks and experimental tools that enable ongoing measurement of monitoring performance as model capabilities evolve.

- Translate research findings into actionable improvements, working with partner teams to strengthen monitoring systems and inform broader safety decisions.

- Establish research priorities and guide technical execution, balancing foundational research questions with practical deployment needs.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have a strong background in machine learning research, particularly in model evaluations, AI safety, alignment, robustness, or related areas.

- Have demonstrated the ability to lead technically challenging research projects, from identifying important questions through designing experiments and delivering results.

- Bring strong experimental judgment and understand how to design evaluations that are rigorous, reproducible, and difficult to game.

- Have hands-on experience building or evaluating machine learning systems, including working with large language models or other frontier AI systems.

- Enjoy investigating complex failure modes and developing methods to distinguish meaningful safety signals from misleading measurements.

- Are comfortable working on open-ended research problems where the right methodology or success criteria may not be obvious at the outset.

- Combine strong research instincts with practical engineering ability and can independently build experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly.

- Communicate technical findings clearly and enjoy collabor

As Senior Counsel on Personify Health ’s commercial legal team, you’ll build the agreements that make our TPA business work, from client administrative services agreements to the network, pharmacy, stop-loss, and vendor partnerships behind them. Counsel senior leaders: Advise executives on deal structure, risk tradeoffs, and commercial terms, translating legal complexity into decisions the business can act on.

•
Run a high-volume practice independently: Manage your own docket across many contract types, taking transactions from intake through execution with minimal oversight.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

• Juris Doctor and active license in good standing in at least one U.S. state

title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Service
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

There is only one Data Cloud. Snowflake’s founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

Our product offering runs on multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Our infrastructure self-optimizes and provides high availability and data protection across cloud providers, so our users can focus on using their data, not managing it.

Our team is the Compute Service team. We build and operate the systems that schedule and run warehouse-backed work beyond a user’s interactive query: asynchronous and scheduled compute, elastic capacity for parts of live queries, and the scheduling control plane those workloads run on. We balance usability, performance, cost, and reliability for the teams and customers that depend on this compute.

We are actively hiring talented distributed systems developers. This role is an opportunity to shape the architecture and operation of core services that the rest of Snowflake runs on.

AS A SENIOR DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

- Solve real business needs at large scale by applying software engineering and analytical problem solving.

- Design and implement scalable distributed systems for scheduling, queueing, dispatch, and completion of warehouse-backed work.

- Analyze fault tolerance, high availability, performance, and scale challenges, and solve them.

- Build admission control, isolation, and capacity management so shared compute stays fair and predictable.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives, and collaborate with engineers, product managers, and technical program managers across teams.

- Judge trade-offs among consistency, durability, latency, and cost, and build systems that meet the demands of rapidly growing services.

- Ensure operational readiness of the services, and meet commitments to customers on availability and performance.

OUR IDEAL DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- Substantial industry experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

- Experience building large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant services and control planes, including compute placement, queueing, and monitoring.

- A strong understanding of operating-system concepts, including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, performance, and scale.

- Strong computer-science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

- Systems programming skills, including multi-threading and concurrency. Fluency in Java is preferred.

- A track record of identifying problems and implementing creative solutions.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

- A BS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

- Build an industry-leading cloud

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.
Find your next move at JLL and build a fulfilling career  
At JLL , we value what makes you unique, and we’re committed to give you the opportunity, knowledge and tools to own your success. Explore opportunities to advance your career from within, whether you’re looking to move up, broaden your experience or deepen your expertise.

About JLL
We’re JLL -a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 91,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers, and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces, and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst - Remote
This individual-contributor role sits on JLL 's Threat Intelligence Program, working across the full intelligence cycle in close partnership with Cyber Defense, engineering, and business leaders. The role requires ownership: you will take problems from ambiguous starting point to briefed conclusion, and you'll be trusted and expected to operate that way. It demands both technical depth and strategic sense, and the judgment to know which the moment calls for.

We view threat intelligence as, at its core, rigorous analytic tradecraft, the discipline of reasoning under uncertainty, quickly and always in service of a stakeholder. We are an actionable support system, and our job is to drive the efficient allocation of resources against the threats that are relevant and timely to JLL . That demands the full range of analytic discipline, source vetting, calibrated confidence, and clear reasoning among them so that what we hand a stakeholder is a defensible assessment, not a repeated claim.

Primary Responsibilities

• Operate across all phases of the intelligence cycle, from requirements through dissemination, exercising sound judgment on scope and priority as new threats emerge.

• Take loosely scoped questions and add the bounds yourself, frame the problem, define what "answered" looks like, and drive it to a conclusion that serves a real stakeholder, not just closes the request.

• Produce intelligence calibrated to its audience, from engineers to executives, with a clear read on who the customer is and what decision they need to make.

• Partner with Cyber Defense and engineering as a technical peer to translate intelligence into mitigation and detection strategies.

• Help guide our intel-architecture requirements, working with engineers to shape the tooling, automation, and data flows that support the team, without needing to be the engineer yourself.

• Help shape and evolve our Priority Intelligence Requirements and Collection Requirements as the threat landscape shifts.

• Prepare and deliver briefings, after-action reports, and program metrics to technical and executive audiences.

title: Läkarstudent till Velora
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens vård för personer med övervikt/obesitas?
Bygg spetskompetens inom obesitasbehandling redan under studietiden. Velora är en digital specialistklinik för behandling av övervikt/obesitas med mål är att ingen ska behöva vara fast i ofrivillig övervikt. Med en kombination av modern forskning, teknik och ett holistiskt synsätt är vi på god väg. Vi söker nu dig som är läkarstudent till vårt växande team.
Utöver möjligheten att verkligen göra skillnad för en eftersatt patientgrupp erbjuder vi både möjlighet till arbete på distans och flexibla arbetstider. Vi tror på att nöjd personal är nyckeln till nöjda patienter. Veloras arbetsklimat präglas av framåtanda, arbetsglädje och gemenskap. Vi brinner för det vi gör och har stor yrkesstolthet kring den vård vi bedriver.
Uppdraget
Du ringer patienter som har avslutat sin behandling hos oss eller har valt att inte gå vidare med den. Du följer upp hur det har gått och svarar på frågor om behandlingen. Du hjälper också patienten att förstå vad viktnedgång och fortsatt behandling kan betyda för hälsan, till exempel för blodtryck, blodsocker, blodfetter, ledbesvär och sömn. Du tränar på att möta patienter i väldigt olika situationer och att föra samtal som kräver både kunskap och lyhördhet. Den information du samlar in använder vi när vi utvecklar vården.
Vem du är
Du är trygg och lyhörd i telefonsamtal och uttrycker dig varmt och tydligt, även i känsliga situationer. Du har god självinsikt, är strukturerad i din dokumentation och hanterar patientuppgifter med hög integritet. Du bidrar med energi och engagemang, och andra trivs med att samarbeta med dig.
Kvalifikationer

• Du studerar på läkarprogrammet, gärna termin 6 eller senare

• Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

• Du är noggrann och strukturerad i din dokumentation

• Du kan arbeta regelbundet under en längre period

Därför stärker detta din karriär
Obesitas är en av vår tids största folksjukdomar och berör nästan alla specialiteter, från allmänmedicin och internmedicin till kirurgi och psykiatri. Hos oss får du:

• Fördjupad kunskap om modern obesitasbehandling, inklusive GLP-1-baserade läkemedel

• Vana att föra svåra och känsliga samtal, en av de viktigaste färdigheterna i läkaryrket

• Konkret erfarenhet av patientkommunikation som du kan sätta på ditt CV och ta med dig till BT och vidare

• Insikt i hur digital vård fungerar i praktiken Referenser från en specialistklinik

Meriterande

• Erfarenhet av svåra eller känsliga samtal.

• Intresse för eller erfarenhet av arbete med personer med övervikt eller obesitas

Arbetstid & ersättning
Rollen kräver att du kan arbeta regelbundet, till exempel 2 timmar varannan dag eller 1 timme om dagen. Du väljer själv när du arbetar, vardagar mellan 10.00 och 20.00. Du får fast timlön med möjlighet till extra ersättning
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

You'll engage with data platform engineers, architects, SRE, and the VP who owns the standard - and your job is to design something that satisfies all of them and then prove it at production scale.

Getting an enterprise team there usually means moving them off something else, so most of your work is making that migration credible: the architecture, benchmarks run against their own data, and a plan their engineers believe they can execute.

This is a role for engineers who want the hard version of the problem: real scale, real constraints, and an incumbent to displace. Prior pre-sales experience helps but isn't required - technical depth is non-negotiable.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Own the technical evaluation for enterprise accounts - from discovery through POC or competitive bake-off, architecture sign-off, security review, and first production workload.

- Engage across a wider set of stakeholders than a single team: data platform engineers, architects, SRE, security, and the executive who owns the standard. Design solutions that hold up with all of them in the room.

- Design for production scale - sizing, sharding and replication strategy, ingestion topology, tiered storage, cost modeling, and what happens when something fails at 3am.

- Win competitive displacements against Elasticsearch, Splunk, Snowflake, BigQuery, Druid, Pinot, and homegrown systems, using benchmarks the customer's own team can reproduce.

- Own the migration plan - sequencing, dual-run, validation, and cutover - so the customer's team can see exactly how they get to production.

- Clear the security and procurement path: questionnaires, compliance artifacts, network and identity architecture, and BYOC or private deployment requirements.

- Partner closely with Enterprise AEs to progress and close opportunities - you own the technical win, they own the commercial close. Build the TCO case against the incumbent/competition together.

- Advocate for customer needs internally with Product and Engineering - you're the voice of the technical buyer inside ClickHouse.

- Contribute reference architectures, benchmark harnesses, migration guides, and objection handling material that help the team scale what's working.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Deep technical foundation in data infrastructure - built through experience as a data engineer, platform engineer, software engineer, DBA, or solutions architect.

- Production experience with analytical databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, Pinot, Vertica) and with operating them, not just querying them.

- Distributed systems judgment: partitioning, replication, consistency trade-offs, query execution, and a felt sense for where things break under load.

- Fluency across the modern data stack - Kafka and CDC pipelines, orchestration, object storage, BI tools, and at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) at architecture level.

- Experience running a technical evaluation against a named competitor and winning it, including designing the migration off the incumbent and the parts of it that are genuinely hard.

- Customer-facing experience with real stakes - pre-sales, consulting, technical account management, or a staff-level engineering role that put you in front of customers.

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can whiteboard with a staff engineer in the morning and present to a VP of Engineering in the afternoon.

- Comfort with longer cycles and more stakeholders. Enterprise evaluations don't close in three weeks, and you know how to keep one moving without letting it stall.

- Willingness to say ClickHouse isn't the right tool for a given workload when that's true.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distrib

What We're Looking For

• Hands-on Project Management experience

title: AI Scientist – Molecular Machine Learning
description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Scientist - Molecular Machine Learning to join our innovative and dynamic team.

AI Scientist - Molecular Machine Learning | About You

As an AI Scientist - Molecular Machine Learning, you will design and develop advanced AI/ML models that accelerate molecular property prediction, molecular generation, and drug discovery. You will apply deep learning, graph neural networks, geometric learning, transformers, and generative AI to complex molecular and chemical datasets, partnering closely with computational chemists and drug discovery scientists to solve high-impact scientific challenges. The ideal candidate is an AI/ML-first scientist with strong model development expertise and demonstrated experience applying machine learning to chemistry, molecular design, or drug discovery.

AI Scientist - Molecular Machine Learning | Day-to-Day

• Design, develop, train, and evaluate deep learning models for molecular property prediction, molecular generation, and drug discovery applications.

• Build molecular AI solutions using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Graph Transformers, geometric deep learning, and generative modeling techniques.

• Develop scalable AI/ML workflows using Python, PyTorch and/or JAX, optimizing models for accuracy, efficiency, and scientific relevance.

• Build and manage molecular datasets and cheminformatics workflows using RDKit and related tools, including molecular representation, preprocessing, feature generation, and model-ready dataset development.

• Develop generative modeling approaches for de novo molecular design, lead optimization, and molecular exploration, leveraging techniques such as diffusion models, flow matching, reinforcement learning, or related architectures.

• Collaborate with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and drug discovery scientists to translate scientific problems into AI/ML approaches and generate actionable insights for molecular discovery programs.

• Evaluate and continuously improve molecular ML models using rigorous experimentation, validation, benchmarking, and reproducible research practices.

AI Scientist - Molecular Machine Learning | Skills & Experience

• Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Computational Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Data Science, Physics, or a related technical or scientific discipline, with relevant experience applying AI/ML to molecular or scientific problems.

• Strong hands-on expertise with PyTorch and/or JAX, including developing, training, evaluating, and optimizing deep learning models.

• Demonstrated experience with Graph Neural Networks, Graph Transformers, geometric deep learning, and generative AI, particularly for molecular representation, property prediction, or molecular design.

• Strong Python programming and cheminformatics experience, including RDKit or comparable toolkits, with experience working with complex molecular datasets.

• Experience applying AI/ML to molecular property prediction, molecular generation, drug discovery, ADMET modeling, lead optimization, or related molecular science applications.

• Experience working within Linux and high-performance computing environments, with exposure to tools such as Schrödinger, MOE, GROMACS, OpenMM, or other molecular modeling platforms considered valuable.

title: Enterprise Alliances Manager
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Enterprise finance teams rarely choose a spend platform alone. ERP vendors, consultancies, procurement and T&E platforms, and technology partners are usually involved. You'll build and run the partnerships that put Airwallex in front of those buyers, turning them into a repeatable source of pipeline and revenue across Europe. This is a hands-on commercial role with a number to hit.

- Define the EMEA partnership strategy, joint business plans, and KPIs, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue, and activation.

- Source, negotiate, and close partners across consultancies and GSIs, ERP and procurement ecosystems, technology partners, and private equity firms.

- Enable partner sales teams to position Airwallex with confidence, and work with Enterprise AEs to bring partners into live deals early.

- Run regular business reviews with priority partners, and own commercial terms, amendments, and renewals with Legal.

- Plan joint events and campaigns with Partner Marketing.

- Feed partner and customer insight to Product, and document what works in repeatable playbooks.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 6+ years in partnerships, alliances, channel, or business development, ideally in SaaS or fintech.

- A quota-carrying background, with a track record of closing enterprise deals or revenue-generating partnerships.

- Experience selling to or through Finance, Procurement, or IT leaders, including CFOs, FDs, and Heads of Procurement.

- A network in at least one of consultancies, ERP or T&E ecosystems, or private equity.

- Confidence structuring and negotiating commercial agreements, and influencing senior stakeholders.

- An ownership mindset: comfortable building from a blank page and measuring the result.

Preferred

- Familiarity with spend management, corporate cards, AP automation, or cross-border payments.

- Experience with marketplace or integration-led partner programmes.

- Additional European languages.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you're motivated by stretch goals.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Financial & Strategic Partnerships builds the relationships that expand what our platform can do and where it can go next. This team structures deals with financial institutions, fintech platforms, and enterprise software companies that embed Airwallex's infrastructure into their own products: commercially complex work that accelerates growth, opens new markets, and extends distribution reach

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

title: Developer Documentation Writer
description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Render seeks a Developer Documentation Writer to help grow and steward our library of technical content. As the docs owner for a defined area of the Render platform, you will ensure that readers and AI agents can find the information they need and trust that it's accurate.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to explain Render's products as they evolve to meet the rapidly changing needs of modern software development.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own documentation for your defined area of the Render platform. Support everything from minor version updates to major launches within that area, while ensuring that existing content remains fresh.

- Deliver a variety of content types as required by the scope and schedule of each project, such as conceptual guides, API/SDK/CLI reference, agent skills, changelog entries, and customer communications.

- Build and deploy example applications on Render to validate platform behavior as part of the documentation process.

- Review documentation contributions from a wide variety of internal contributors, providing thoughtful feedback and guidance.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience in crafting genuinely useful documentation for developers

- Pithy, expressive writing

- Judicious, proactive application of AI to assess accuracy, reduce toil, and strengthen content (not to replace authorship)

- Familiarity with common considerations for multi-service architectures, including execution boundaries, independent deployments, and data persistence

- Comfort working with Git and the command line

- Kindness, grace, and empathy in all forms of communication

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience with hosting, infrastructure, or DevOps products

- Experience authoring and maintaining AI

Capco is a global technology and management consultancy specializing in driving digital transformation in the financial services and insurance industries. Capco is committed to providing clients with practical solutions. We offer a globally integrated service with offices in leading financial centers across the globe. We have the people, the vision, and the passion.

We are growing through a significant growth journey, now is a very good time to join us as we expand geographically, increase headcount and disrupt the consulting market across APAC with entrepreneurial and agile thinking.

We are:

• Experts in banking and payments, capital markets and wealth and asset management

• Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Core Banking etc.

• Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there

• Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

 

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

We are currently seeking a Senior/Principal Consultant  to support and drive the growth of our Securities Services practice, with a strong focus on Custody Transformation. This is an exciting opportunity to be a leader, driving complex client programs, shape delivery approaches, and building consulting capability across the practice. 

As a Senior/Principal Consultant within the Securities Services team, you will lead custody transformation projects across custody operation and securities services for top-tier financial institutions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Proven track record leading  custody and securities services transformation programmes , including operating model redesign, process re-engineering, automation, and platform modernization.

• Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to advise senior business and technology leaders.

• Demonstrated programme leadership experience, managing complex transformation initiatives and cross-functional teams.

• Proven experience in business development, client relationship management, opportunity identification, and proposal leadership.

• Experience contributing to practice development through methodologies, frameworks, and thought leadership.

• Immediately Available Preferred!

 

Why Join CAPCO

• Work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks/insurance in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture

• Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications

• Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services

• Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified - giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship .

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes-from emerging brands to Fortune 500s-use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

About the role

Flexport is hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to do full funnel marketing, including acquisition, expansion, and nurture. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in San Francisco, reporting to the Director of Growth Marketing.

You’ll manage channels directly, build the tracking and experimentation systems that show what works, and use AI-first workflows to get more done with a lean team. You’ll partner with Brand & Event Marketing, Sales, Sales & Marketing Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to win new accounts and expand existing ones.

What you’ll do

Channel owner & operator

• Manage paid media for acquisition and expansion across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and YouTube, from campaign structure and bidding to audience development.

• Forecast and allocate budget, and decide what to scale or stop based on qualified pipeline and expansion revenue.

• Own AEO and SEO: understand ranking factors, fill content gaps, increase share of relevant volume, and stay on top of changes in LLM and agentic search.

• Build account-based programs with Sales and Customer Success: define target accounts, use buying signals, and coordinate campaigns with sales outreach and events.

• Lead agency and vendor partners with clear briefs and accountability.

Messaging, conversion, and customer marketing

• Develop value propositions, differentiation, and persona-based messaging grounded in customer research, competitive positioning, and Product narratives that convert in each channel.

• Optimize landing pages and conversion paths, including offers and personalization by segment.

• Build customer marketing programs for account expansion and attach: segment customers by usage and whitespace, and run cross-sell and upsell campaigns.

Measurement and experimentation

• Build and maintain the tracking foundation: tag management, server-side tracking, conversion APIs, and offline conversion imports that send CRM outcomes back to ad platforms.

• Connect spend to pipeline, expansion, and attach revenue using unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback period, contribution margin) and multi-touch and self-reported attribution.

• Prove incrementality with holdout and geo-lift tests, and model adstock and diminishing returns to guide channel investment.

• Run a documented, hypothesis-driven experimentation program across audiences, bids, offers, creative, and landing pages, with clear readouts.

• Use SQL and data science to segment audiences and analyze cohorts, and use reverse ETL to push modeled audiences into ad and lifecycle platforms.

• Work with Sales & Marketing Operations on campaign tracking, lead flow to sales handoff, and lead quality and account expansion analysis.

AI-first growth stack

Marketplace Director
Location: Remote
Type: Full-Time, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM New York (Eastern), Mon - Fri (5 days)
Compensation: Competitive salary + performance incentives
A growing U.S. door hardware brand is seeking an experienced, hands-on Marketplace Director to take full ownership of our non-Amazon marketplaces and drive profitable sales growth.
Responsibilities

• Manage and grow Home Depot, Lowe's, Wayfair, Walmart, Tractor Supply, Bed Bath & Beyond, and additional marketplaces.

• Develop and execute marketplace-specific growth strategies.

• Optimize listings, pricing, advertising, SEO, and conversion rates.

• Resolve inactive SKUs, catalog issues, and account performance problems.

• Oversee marketplace operations, integrations, and account health.

• Lead internal team members and ensure accountability.

• Provide weekly reporting, sales targets, and measurable results.

• Identify and launch new marketplace opportunities.

Requirements

• 5+ years of marketplace management experience.

• Proven record of growing major U.S. retail marketplace accounts.

• Experience in handling Home Depot, Lowe's, Mirkale, TSC

• Strong knowledge of marketplace advertising, catalog management, and profitability.

• Excellent English communication and leadership skills.

• Analytical, proactive, independent, and highly execution-focused.

• Experience in home improvement or building materials preferred.

Ideal Candidate
A strategic leader who is also a hands-on operator, capable of taking complete ownership, solving problems independently, and delivering measurable revenue growth.
Amazon is managed separately and is excluded from this role.
